items.text:
Keep answers short
preference
Communication style
I prefer concise answers: lead with the answer, then at most three short paragraphs of supporting detail. Skip preambles like "Great question".

Bullet points for options
preference
Communication style
When comparing options, use a bulleted list or a small table rather than long prose.

No emojis
instruction
Communication style
Don't use emojis in anything you write for me, including commit messages, documents and chat replies.

British spelling in writing
instruction
Communication style
Use British English spelling (colour, organise, licence) in documents and emails. Code identifiers can stay American.

Email tone with clients
preference
Communication style
Client emails should be warm but brief: greet them by first name, two or three short paragraphs, a clear next step, and sign off with "Best, Sam".

Writing to my family in Spanish
relationship
Communication style, Personal preferences
I write to my parents and my sister in Spanish (Rioplatense, using "vos"). Messages to them should be informal and affectionate.

How I like feedback
preference
Communication style
Give direct critical feedback first, then what works. I'd rather hear that a plan has a flaw than be reassured.

Meeting notes format
instruction
Communication style
Meeting summaries: decisions first, then action items with an owner and a date, then open questions. No transcript-style narration.

Technical depth of explanations
preference
Communication style
I'm a senior engineer: skip beginner explanations of programming concepts, but do explain unfamiliar domain terms (medical, legal, tax).

Ask before assuming
instruction
Communication style
If a request is ambiguous in a way that changes the result, ask one clarifying question instead of guessing. For small details, pick a sensible default and say so.

Slack style with the Harbor team
preference
Communication style, Project context
Slack messages to the Harbor team should be one or two lines, no headings; use threads for anything longer.

Dates and times
preference
Communication style
Use 24-hour time and day-month-year dates (16 Oct 2026). My time zone is Europe/Lisbon.

Metric units
preference
Communication style, Personal preferences
Use metric units: kilometres, kilograms, degrees Celsius. Convert recipes from cups and ounces to grams and millilitres.

No flattery
preference
Communication style
Don't praise my questions or ideas. A neutral, matter-of-fact tone works best for me.

Blog writing voice
instruction
Communication style
For my blog posts: first person, plain words, short sentences, one idea per paragraph, and no marketing language like "unlock" or "supercharge".

Slide decks
preference
Communication style
Slides should carry one message each and at most 20 words of text; put the detail in the speaker notes.

Summaries of articles
instruction
Communication style
When summarizing an article, give a three-sentence summary and then the one claim I should double-check.

When you make a mistake
instruction
Communication style
If you got something wrong, say what was wrong and fix it. No long apologies.

Learning Portuguese
goal
Communication style, Personal preferences
I'm learning European Portuguese (around A2). When I ask, correct my Portuguese gently and explain the grammar rule in English.

Prefer async communication
preference
Communication style
I prefer async written communication over calls. Suggest a call only when a thread has gone back and forth more than three times.

Proposals to new clients
instruction
Communication style, Project context
Proposals should start with the client's problem in their own words, then scope, timeline, price, and what is out of scope.

Long documents
preference
Communication style
Documents longer than a page need headings and a short summary at the top.

Language with the sailing club
fact
Communication style, Project context
Emails to the sailing club can be in English; they usually reply in Portuguese, which I can read slowly.

Coffee order
preference
Personal preferences
Oat milk flat white, no sugar. If oat milk isn't available, a black americano.

Coffee at home
preference
Personal preferences
On weekend mornings I make pour-over coffee with a V60 and light-roast beans, ground fresh.

Favourite café to work from
fact
Personal preferences
I work from Café Lume most Tuesday and Thursday mornings: good wifi, quiet until 11.

Vegetarian
fact
Personal preferences, Health
I've been vegetarian since 2019. I eat eggs and dairy but no meat or fish, including fish sauce and gelatin.

Favourite cuisines
preference
Personal preferences
I love Japanese, Ethiopian and South Indian food. Not a fan of very sweet desserts.

Focus music
preference
Personal preferences
For deep work I listen to ambient or instrumental post-rock; lyrics distract me.

Reading taste
preference
Personal preferences
I read mostly science fiction and popular history, and prefer paper books to e-books.

Travel style
preference
Personal preferences
I prefer trains over flights for trips under six hours, aisle seats, and small guesthouses over big hotel chains.

Sailing
fact
Personal preferences
I sail dinghies at the Tejo Sailing Club on weekends from April to October.

Bouldering
fact
Personal preferences, Health
I go bouldering twice a week, usually Monday and Wednesday evenings.

Running routine
fact
Personal preferences, Health
I run three times a week, about 30 km in total, mostly along the river early in the morning.

Best hours for focused work
constraint
Personal preferences
I do my best focused work between 7:00 and 11:00. Avoid scheduling meetings for me before 11:00.

Desk setup
fact
Personal preferences
I use a standing desk, a split keyboard and a single 27-inch monitor.

Houseplants
fact
Personal preferences
I keep about fifteen houseplants, mostly tropical, and I'm bad at remembering to water them.

Balcony garden
fact
Personal preferences
I grow tomatoes, basil and chillies on the balcony; I usually plant in March.

My cat
fact
Personal preferences
I have a grey cat called Miso, six years old and indoor only. A neighbour feeds her when I travel.

Gift ideas for Jordan
relationship
Personal preferences
Jordan likes ceramics, specialty tea and hiking gear. Avoid scented candles.

Partner
relationship
Personal preferences
My partner is Jordan; we've lived together since 2022. Jordan is a nurse who works rotating shifts.

Sister
relationship
Personal preferences
My sister Lucía lives in Montevideo with her two kids, aged 8 and 5.

Parents
relationship
Personal preferences
My parents live in Buenos Aires. I call them on Sunday afternoons, Lisbon time.

Family birthdays
event
Personal preferences
Jordan's birthday is 12 March and Lucía's is 30 July. Remind me two weeks ahead so I can send something.

Clothing sizes
fact
Personal preferences
Shirt size M, trousers 32/32, shoes EU 43.

Films
preference
Personal preferences
I like slow science fiction and documentaries. I dislike horror.

Podcasts
preference
Personal preferences
On runs I listen to podcasts about history and economics; no true crime.

Cooking on weeknights
preference
Personal preferences
I cook most weeknights and like one-pot recipes that take under 40 minutes. I have a pressure cooker and a cast-iron pan.

Languages I speak
fact
Personal preferences, Communication style
Native Spanish speaker, fluent in English, learning Portuguese.

Saturdays offline
constraint
Personal preferences, Project context
I try to stay offline on Saturdays: no work email or Slack until Sunday evening.

Japan trip
event
Personal preferences
Planning two weeks in Japan in April 2027: Tokyo, Kanazawa and Kyoto, travelling by rail.

No car
fact
Personal preferences
I don't own a car; I get around by metro, bike and the occasional car share.

Alcohol
preference
Personal preferences, Health
I rarely drink, at most a glass of wine at the weekend. I prefer alcohol-free options at events.

Swift style
instruction
Software development
Swift: prefer value types and protocols, avoid force unwraps outside tests, use guard for early exits, and keep functions under about 40 lines.

Swift concurrency
instruction
Software development
Use async/await and actors instead of completion handlers or GCD in new code, with strict concurrency checking on.

Swift Testing
instruction
Software development
New Swift tests use Swift Testing (@Test, #expect), not XCTest, except for UI tests.

Python conventions
instruction
Software development
Python scripts: Python 3.12, type hints everywhere, ruff for lint and format, pathlib instead of os.path, and a main() guarded by __name__.

TypeScript conventions
instruction
Software development
TypeScript in strict mode, no 'any', zod for runtime validation, pnpm as the package manager.

Commit messages
instruction
Software development
Commit messages: imperative subject under 60 characters, a blank line, then why the change was made. No conventional-commit prefixes.

Git workflow
instruction
Software development
Feature branches off main, squash-merged via pull request. Rebase rather than merge to update a branch. Never force-push to main.

Testing approach
instruction
Software development
Write tests for behaviour, not implementation. Prefer fakes over mocks. A bug fix starts with a failing test.

Code review style
instruction
Software development, Communication style
In code reviews, separate blocking issues from nits and label nits as "nit:". Suggest code rather than only describing the problem.

Editors
fact
Software development
I use Xcode for Swift and Neovim for everything else, with a light theme during the day.

Shell tools
preference
Software development
zsh with a minimal prompt; ripgrep, fd, jq and fzf daily. Prefer one-liners that work with macOS's BSD tools.

Third-party dependencies
constraint
Software development
Be conservative with third-party dependencies: pin exact versions, check the licence and maintenance activity, and prefer the standard library.

Databases
preference
Software development
Default to SQLite for local apps and Postgres for servers. Write SQL by hand; avoid heavy ORMs.

Documentation
instruction
Software development
Every repository gets a README covering what it does, how to run it and how to test it. Decisions go in short ADRs.

Error handling
instruction
Software development
Use typed errors and never swallow errors silently. Log with context but never log user data or secrets.

Server logs
constraint
Software development, Privacy preferences
Server logs must not include request bodies or personal data; IDs and timings only.

Continuous integration
preference
Software development
GitHub Actions for CI: every pull request must pass lint, tests and a build, and pipelines should stay under 10 minutes.

Hosting side projects
fact
Software development
I host side projects on a single Hetzner VPS with Docker Compose and Caddy. No Kubernetes.

API design
instruction
Software development
REST APIs: plural nouns, cursor pagination, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, and error bodies with a machine-readable code.

Naming
preference
Software development
Prefer descriptive names over abbreviations; booleans read as assertions (isEnabled, hasAccess).

Code formatting
instruction
Software development
Swift is formatted with swift-format: 4-space indentation and a 120-column limit.

Accessibility
constraint
Software development
UI work must support VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and dark mode from the start, not as a follow-up.

Performance work
instruction
Software development
Measure before optimizing, and include before/after numbers in pull requests that claim speedups.

Secrets in code
constraint
Software development, Privacy preferences
Never put API keys in source or config files committed to git. Use the Keychain locally and environment variables in CI.

Code you write for me
instruction
Software development, Communication style
When you write code for me, give the complete file or a precise diff, and say what you didn't test.

Programming languages I know
fact
Software development
Strong in Swift, Python, TypeScript and SQL; comfortable with Go; rusty in Java; never used Rust in production.

Target platforms
constraint
Software development
My apps target macOS 15+ and iOS 18+. I don't support older OS versions in new projects.

Development machine
fact
Software development
My main machine is a MacBook Pro M1 with 16 GB of RAM; builds shouldn't assume more memory than that.

Data analysis
preference
Software development
For quick data analysis I use Python with pandas in Jupyter, and plain matplotlib charts.

Open-source licence
fact
Software development, Legal
My open-source projects use the Apache-2.0 licence.

Dates in code
instruction
Software development
Store timestamps in UTC and convert to local time only at the edges. Never parse dates with hand-written regexes.

Work in small steps
instruction
Software development, Communication style
I like to work in small reviewable steps: propose a plan first for anything bigger than one file.

Destructive commands
constraint
Software development
Before running destructive shell commands (rm -rf, force-push, dropping tables), stop and ask me.

SwiftUI
instruction
Software development
SwiftUI with the Observation framework (@Observable), no Combine in new code, and a preview for every view.

Backups of my work
fact
Software development
Projects live in ~/Projects and are backed up with Time Machine plus a nightly restic job to remote storage.

Technical learning goals
goal
Software development
This year I want to learn Rust well enough to ship a small CLI, and get better at database internals.

Harbor app
project context
Project context
Harbor is a booking app I'm building for the Tejo Sailing Club: members reserve dinghies and instructors. iOS app plus a small Go API.

Harbor client contact
relationship
Project context, Finance
The Harbor project is paid for by the sailing club. The treasurer, Marta Silva, approves invoices and prefers email to phone calls.

Harbor tech stack
project context
Project context, Software development
Harbor: SwiftUI app, Go API on the VPS, Postgres, push notifications via APNs. Payments are out of scope for v1.

Harbor milestones
event
Project context
Harbor beta to club members by 15 Jan 2027; App Store submission by 1 March 2027.

Harbor design decisions
project context
Project context
Harbor shows bookings in a calendar grid, has a 48-hour cancellation rule, and lets instructors block out times.

Harbor's users
project context
Project context
About 120 club members, many over 60 and not comfortable with technology; large text and simple flows matter.

Harbor known issue
project context
Project context, Software development
Harbor beta blocker: booking confirmations show the wrong time zone for members abroad.

Ledgerly
project context
Project context, Software development, Finance
Ledgerly is my open-source command-line budgeting tool in Python. It imports bank CSV exports and categorizes transactions with rules.

Ledgerly roadmap
goal
Project context
Next for Ledgerly: support for Portuguese bank CSV formats and a monthly report command.

Ledgerly community
summary
Project context
Ledgerly has about 300 GitHub stars and a few regular contributors; I want to keep it dependency-light.

Nordwind Atlas migration
project context
Project context
Contract with Nordwind Logistics: migrating their Atlas dispatch system from a PHP monolith to a TypeScript service, two days a week until December 2026.

Nordwind confidentiality
constraint
Project context, Privacy preferences, Legal
Nordwind's code and data are under NDA. Never paste their code, schemas or customer names into external tools or chatbots.

Nordwind contacts
relationship
Project context
At Nordwind my lead is Erik Halvorsen, the CTO. Standups are at 9:30 CET on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Book project
project context
Project context, Personal preferences
I'm writing a short beginner's book on balcony gardening: target 40,000 words, first draft due June 2027.

Blog
project context
Project context
I blog monthly on my personal site about indie app development; posts run 800 to 1,500 words.

Kitchen renovation
project context
Project context, Finance
Planning a kitchen renovation for spring 2027 with a budget of €12,000. We want an induction hob and more counter space.

Marathon goal
goal
Project context, Health
Training for the Lisbon Marathon in October 2027, aiming to finish under 3h45.

Availability for new work
constraint
Project context
I'm fully booked until January 2027; new client work can start in February at the earliest.

Day rate
fact
Project context, Finance
My freelance day rate is €650; the minimum engagement is five days.

Conference talk
event
Project context
Giving a talk on offline-first iOS apps at a Swift conference in Porto in May 2027; slides due in April.

Mentoring
fact
Project context
I mentor two junior developers through a local women-in-tech programme, one hour every other Friday.

Idea backlog
goal
Project context
Ideas I keep coming back to: a plant-watering reminder app, a recipe scaler, and a CLI that checks weather windows for dinghy sailing.

Open-source GPX library
project context
Project context, Software development
I maintain a small Swift library for parsing GPX files and triage its issues on Sunday evenings.

Coworking desk
fact
Project context
I rent a desk at a coworking space in Cais do Sodré on Mondays and Fridays.

Q4 2026 priorities
goal
Project context
Q4 2026 priorities: ship the Harbor beta, finish Nordwind phase 2, and publish two blog posts.

Distributed systems course
fact
Project context
I'm taking an online course on distributed systems; assignments are due every Sunday.

Working while travelling
constraint
Project context
When I travel I keep client work to mornings and stay reachable by email only.

Harbor Android subcontractor
relationship
Project context
For Harbor's Android version I may subcontract to Priya, a Kotlin developer I've worked with before.

Task tracking
fact
Project context
I track client tasks in Linear and personal projects in plain Markdown files.

Home address
constraint
Privacy preferences
Never share my home address or put it in documents for clients; use the coworking address for business mail.

Nieces and nephews
constraint
Privacy preferences
Don't mention my sister's children by name or share their photos in anything public.

Health information and work
constraint
Privacy preferences, Health
Health details must never be shared with work-related agents or included in client communications.

Location and routine
constraint
Privacy preferences
Don't reveal my real-time location or daily routine (gym times, café visits) to third parties.

Screenshots
instruction
Privacy preferences
Blur names and email addresses in any screenshot used in blog posts or bug reports.

Phone number
constraint
Privacy preferences
My phone number is only for family and close friends. Clients get email and Slack.

Social media
preference
Privacy preferences
I'm not on Facebook or Instagram, only Mastodon and LinkedIn. Don't suggest posting personal news publicly.

Opting out of AI training
preference
Privacy preferences
I prefer tools that don't train on my data, and opt out of model training wherever there's a setting.

Analytics in my apps
constraint
Privacy preferences, Software development
My apps use privacy-preserving analytics only: no third-party trackers and no advertising identifiers.

Financial details
constraint
Privacy preferences, Finance
Don't share my income, account balances or rates with anyone except my accountant.

Jordan's privacy
constraint
Privacy preferences
Jordan prefers not to be named online; refer to "my partner" in public writing.

Photo metadata
instruction
Privacy preferences
Strip location metadata from photos before sharing them.

Passwords
constraint
Privacy preferences
All passwords live in a password manager. Never ask me to paste a password or recovery code into a chat.

Email aliases
preference
Privacy preferences
I use a separate email alias for every online service, so sign-ups should use a fresh alias.

Recording calls
constraint
Privacy preferences
Don't record or transcribe calls without asking everyone on the call first.

Client data retention
constraint
Privacy preferences, Legal
Delete client datasets from my machine within 30 days of a project ending.

Penicillin allergy
fact
Health
I'm allergic to penicillin (it gives me hives), and to amoxicillin too.

Peanut allergy
fact
Health, Personal preferences
Mild peanut allergy: no peanuts or peanut oil. Tree nuts are fine.

Migraines
fact
Health
I get migraines about twice a month, often triggered by poor sleep or skipped meals. I take sumatriptan when one starts.

Lower back pain
fact
Health
My lower back flares up when I sit too long, so I stand every hour and do physio exercises.

Physio routine
instruction
Health
Daily physio routine: cat-cow, bird-dog and glute bridges, about ten minutes.

Sleep
goal
Health
I aim for 7.5 hours of sleep and to be in bed by 23:00, with screens off 30 minutes before.

Caffeine cutoff
constraint
Health, Personal preferences
No caffeine after 14:00 because it ruins my sleep. Decaf or herbal tea in the afternoon.

Supplements and medication
fact
Health
Vitamin D daily in winter. No regular prescription medication apart from migraine tablets when needed.

Family doctor
relationship
Health
My GP is Dr. Ana Ferreira at the local health centre; I book appointments through the health service app.

Dental check-ups
event
Health
Dental check-up every six months; the next one is in December 2026.

Eye strain
fact
Health
I get eye strain after long screen sessions. I follow the 20-20-20 rule and have computer glasses.

Runner's knee
constraint
Health, Personal preferences
Recovering from runner's knee in my left knee: avoid downhill running and keep long runs under 18 km until January.

Lactose intolerance
fact
Health, Personal preferences
I'm slightly lactose intolerant: small amounts of cheese are fine, but I avoid drinking milk.

Blood test results
event
Health
Annual blood test in September 2026: everything normal except slightly low iron. The doctor suggested more legumes and leafy greens.

Stress and tension headaches
fact
Health
When my workload gets heavy I get tension headaches; a 20-minute walk helps more than anything.

Therapy sessions
constraint
Health, Privacy preferences
I see a therapist every other Thursday evening; don't schedule anything then.

Vaccinations
fact
Health
Flu shot every October; tetanus booster due in 2029.

Drinking water
instruction
Health
Remind me to drink water during long coding sessions; I forget.

Heart-rate zones
fact
Health
Easy runs at a heart rate under 145 bpm; my measured maximum is 188.

Protein intake
goal
Health, Personal preferences
As a vegetarian runner I aim for about 100 g of protein a day from eggs, tofu, tempeh and lentils.

Health insurance
fact
Health, Finance
Private health insurance through my employer-independent plan; it partly covers dental.

Sun protection
fact
Health
Fair skin that burns easily: SPF 50 for sailing and running, plus a hat.

Hay fever
fact
Health
Seasonal pollen allergy in April and May; cetirizine helps.

Running shoes
fact
Health, Personal preferences
I run in neutral cushioned shoes and replace them every 700 km.

Bank accounts
fact
Finance
A personal current account at a Portuguese bank, plus a multi-currency account for client payments in euros and pounds.

Monthly budget
fact
Finance
Monthly budget: rent €1,350, groceries €450, transport €60, eating out €200. I review it on the first Sunday of the month.

Emergency fund
goal
Finance
Keep six months of expenses as an emergency fund; currently at about four months.

Investing approach
preference
Finance
Low-cost index funds only, with monthly automatic contributions. No individual stocks.

Retirement plan
instruction
Finance
Contribute to a Portuguese PPR retirement plan every December for the tax deduction.

Freelance social security
fact
Finance, Legal
As a self-employed freelancer I file quarterly social security declarations in January, April, July and October.

Annual tax return
event
Finance, Legal
The annual income tax return is due between April and June; my accountant files it.

Accountant
relationship
Finance
My accountant, Rui Costa, handles taxes and VAT. Send him invoices and receipts by the 10th of each month.

VAT on invoices
fact
Finance, Legal
I charge 23% VAT to Portuguese clients; EU business clients get the reverse charge, with their VAT number on the invoice.

Quarterly VAT returns
event
Finance, Legal
VAT returns are quarterly, due by the 20th of the second month after each quarter ends.

Invoicing terms
instruction
Finance
Invoices are due net 30 and are issued on the last working day of the month through certified invoicing software.

Late payments
instruction
Finance, Communication style
If a client is more than 15 days late, send a polite payment reminder; after 30 days, a firmer one that mentions late fees.

Currency for quotes
preference
Finance
Quote prices in euros; UK clients may pay in pounds at the day's exchange rate.

Subscriptions
instruction
Finance
Review subscriptions every quarter and cancel anything I haven't used in two months.

Rent payment
fact
Finance, Legal
Rent is €1,350, paid on the 1st by bank transfer to the landlord, Mr. Duarte.

Business expenses
instruction
Finance
Keep receipts for hardware, software, coworking and conference travel; they're business expenses.

Buying a flat
goal
Finance
Considering buying a flat in 2028; I'd need about €60,000 for the down payment and costs.

Insurance renewals
fact
Finance, Legal
Home contents insurance and professional liability insurance both renew in February.

Donations
fact
Finance
I donate 2% of my income each year, split between a climate charity and a local food bank.

Supporting my parents
fact
Finance
I send my parents €200 a month by transfer; the amount can vary with the exchange rate.

No crypto
constraint
Finance
I don't buy cryptocurrency or NFTs and don't want suggestions about them.

Which card to use
preference
Finance
Use the credit card for travel bookings because of its travel insurance; the debit card for everything else.

Spending tracking
fact
Finance, Project context
I track spending with Ledgerly in these categories: housing, food, transport, health, fun and business.

Income
fact
Finance
Freelance income in 2025 was roughly €78,000 before tax, varying a lot month to month.

Japan trip budget
fact
Finance, Personal preferences
Budget for the April 2027 Japan trip: €4,000 for two people, not counting flights.

Paying for the renovation
constraint
Finance
The kitchen renovation will be paid from savings, not with a loan.

Rental lease
fact
Legal
The rental lease runs until 31 August 2027. Notice of non-renewal must be given 120 days before, and rent increases are capped by law.

Business structure
fact
Legal, Finance
I work as a self-employed sole trader, not a company. I'm considering forming a limited company in 2027 if income keeps growing.

Client contracts
instruction
Legal
Every client engagement needs a signed contract with scope, payment terms, IP assignment on full payment, and liability capped at the fees paid.

NDAs
constraint
Legal
I sign mutual NDAs only; one-way NDAs need review by my lawyer first.

Lawyer
relationship
Legal
My lawyer, Inês Matos, reviews contracts over €10,000 and anything with non-compete clauses.

Non-compete clauses
constraint
Legal
Never accept a non-compete clause longer than six months.

Will
fact
Legal
I have a will, drafted in 2025, naming Jordan as executor; the original is with the notary.

Residency status
fact
Legal, Privacy preferences
I'm an EU citizen living in Portugal with a registration certificate.

GDPR for Harbor
project context
Legal, Project context, Privacy preferences
Harbor stores members' names, phone numbers and booking history. The sailing club is the data controller and I'm the processor under a data processing agreement.

App privacy labels
instruction
Legal, Software development
Every app I ship needs an accurate App Store privacy label and a privacy policy page.

Ledgerly name
fact
Legal, Project context
I checked that the name Ledgerly has no trademark conflict in the EU; it isn't registered.

Contributor terms
fact
Legal, Software development
Ledgerly accepts contributions under the DCO sign-off; no CLA.

IP ownership
fact
Legal
Code I write for clients belongs to them once paid; I keep the right to reuse general-purpose utilities.

Power of attorney
fact
Legal
My sister Lucía holds power of attorney for my affairs in Uruguay.

Dispute with a former client
event
Legal, Finance
A small claim against a former client over an unpaid €2,400 invoice settled in July 2026. Don't work with them again.

Reading terms of service
instruction
Legal, Privacy preferences
When summarizing terms of service, flag data sharing, auto-renewal, arbitration and liability limits.
